title_en: Is the Mahdist Creed Mutawatir or Based on Isolated Reports? - Episode 2
description_en: Is the Mahdist Creed Mutawatir or Based on Isolated Reports? - Episode 2, an episode of the Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya program by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: An episode exploring whether the doctrine of the Mahdi rests on mutawatir (mass-transmitted) evidence or solitary reports.
